translations.web: Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented, gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them. There were with him about four hundred men.
translations.bsb: And all who were distressed or indebted or discontented rallied around him, and he became their leader. About four hundred men were with him.
